notes.title: Shattered 1.1.0 update is here!
notes.content:
A new update is now live that improves Shattered's gameplay, storyline, and horrific elements. Watch for a sale coming soon that will accompany the update! Also, feel free to take a look at the new trailer and screenshots that have been added to the store page. 

Changes in the update include:

- Zombies are given a new, disturbing look
   * Warts have green, glowing puss
   * Harder to see from a distance
   * The look varies from zombie to zombie

- More differences between the beginning days and the later days
   * Birds are no longer present in the later days
   * Cricket sound effect is replaced in the later days
   * 'Close to zombie' sound effects vary depending on the day
   * Eerie blue fog appears more often in later days
   * Added image effects in the later days to create an eerie environment

Added inventory items that give further help and explanation to the player
   * Includes two letters written by the creator of the shrine that give direction and tips to the villager
   * Includes a map that can be obtained by completing a certain task

- Minor improvements to the map to further bring the storyline to life
   * More obvious map boundaries
   * Village appears more ransacked
   * Wheat field is more densely packed

- Other minor improvements that fix bugs and enhance the quality of the game.
